From 0f28ede906a8ad44158a6ef9471a5a412343cced Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: John Garry <john.garry@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2016 01:31:17 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] hisi_sas: fix v1 hw check for slot error

Completion header bit CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD flags whether the response
frame is received into host memory, and not whether the response frame
has an error.  As such, change the decision on whether a slot has an
error.  Also redundant check on CMPLT_HDR_CMD_CMPLT_MSK is removed.

Fixes: 27a3f229 ("hisi_sas: Add cq interrupt handler")

Signed-off-by: John Garry <john.garry@huawei.com>
Tested-by: Ricardo Salveti <ricardo.salveti@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/hisi_sas/hisi_sas_v1_hw.c b/drivers/scsi/hisi_sas/hisi_sas_v1_hw.c
index d54381149c0d..d04808ef6b2b 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/hisi_sas/hisi_sas_v1_hw.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/hisi_sas/hisi_sas_v1_hw.c
@@ -1293,13 +1293,10 @@ static int slot_complete_v1_hw(struct hisi_hba *hisi_hba,
 		goto out;
 	}
 
-	if (cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_ERR_RCRD_XFRD_MSK) {
-		if (!(cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_CMD_CMPLT_MSK) ||
-		    !(cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK))
-			ts->stat = SAS_DATA_OVERRUN;
-		else
-			slot_err_v1_hw(hisi_hba, task, slot);
+	if (cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_ERR_RCRD_XFRD_MSK &&
+		!(cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK)) {
 
+		slot_err_v1_hw(hisi_hba, task, slot);
 		goto out;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/scsi/hisi_sas/hisi_sas_v1_hw.c`**
- The conditional check for determining if a slot has an error has been modified. 
- The previous logic checked for both `CMPLT_HDR_CMD_CMPLT_MSK` and `CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK` to decide if a slot had an error, which was incorrect.
- The redundant check for `CMPLT_HDR_CMD_CMPLT_MSK` has been removed.
- The new logic now only checks if `CMPLT_HDR_ERR_RCRD_XFRD_MSK` is set and `CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK` is not set to determine if a slot error occurred, leading to a call to `slot_err_v1_hw`.

### Relationships
- The modifications in the `hisi_sas_v1_hw.c` file directly address a bug related to how slot errors were being detected in the hardware interface for the Hisilicon SAS controller. 
- The patch corrects the logic that was introduced in a previous commit (identified by the fix reference `27a3f229`), indicating that the earlier implementation had a flaw in error handling that this patch aims to rectify. 
- The changes improve the accuracy of error detection, ensuring that the system correctly identifies when a response frame has not been received, which is critical for proper hardware operation.

```c

```
```c
else

```
Reason:
The original implementation incorrectly used both `CMPLT_HDR_CMD_CMPLT_MSK` and `CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK` to determine if a slot had an error. This led to incorrect error detection because it did not accurately reflect whether the response frame was received into host memory, which is essential for proper error handling.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_ERR_RCRD_XFRD_MSK &&
    !(cmplt_hdr_data & CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK)) {
```
```c
slot_err_v1_hw(hisi_hba, task, slot);
```
Reason:
The fix changes the conditional check to only consider the error record flag `CMPLT_HDR_ERR_RCRD_XFRD_MSK` and whether the response frame was received into host memory using `CMPLT_HDR_RSPNS_XFRD_MSK`. This ensures that the error handling logic correctly identifies when a slot has an error, thus preventing incorrect error detection.
